audit: Mando868 Counterpart Audit against the AutoPilot Behavioral Contract
scope_note: Not a semantic classification pass over Mando868 residual functions. Built from existing canonical docs (action-command-map.md, command-inventory.md, bidirectional-protocol.md, manual-mode-and-limits.md, auto-mode-and-plus-command.md, motor-config-persistence.md, trigger-input.md, protocol-pipeline.md) first; two items required one bounded new query each (see investigations_performed).

contract_items.autopilot_behavior: Dispatcher arms 0x200025e1=2 (manual-move gate) and schedules pending[17]; outbound dispatcher emits single byte 0x23 ('#') via 0x7f84.
contract_items.remote_producer_consumer: Producer: 0xb680 builds 'G<channel><type><seq>|' (seq starts at '0', pre-increment stored). Consumer/ack: 0xb59c (send at 0xb5ca, retry-exhausted branch at 0xb638, wake-flag 0x20000fc8, G-buffer 0x2000183c).
contract_items.retry_timeout_behavior: 0xb59c is a real send/retry/ack loop; exact retry count/timeout duration not uniformly cited in existing evidence (qualitative mechanism proven, not the precise N).
contract_items.remote_state_updated: None beyond internal ack bookkeeping (R4=1 on accept).
contract_items.ui_workflow_trigger: PROBABLE only -- action-command-map.md workflow 5 explicitly notes no string has been traced to 0xb680's call site ('GO TO POINT'/'Move to A-D' plausible landmarks, unproven mapping).
contract_items.compatibility_requirement: Replacement AutoPilot must accept 'G<ch><type><seq>|' and respond with a single 0x23 byte for the Remote's ack loop to accept.
contract_items.missing_fact: exact 0xb59c retry count / timeout duration not extracted from existing evidence

contract_items.autopilot_behavior: Schedules event 6, computes value0 (and value1/bool for extended form) in one pass.
contract_items.remote_producer_consumer: Producer/consumer: 0xc440 (shared with !). Sends 'S|', parses 'P<value0>,' or 'P<value0>,<value1>,<bool>,' via decimal-field parser 0xb51c.
contract_items.retry_timeout_behavior: The bulk-push gate (item 7) treats 'a clean P-prefixed response within ~200 ticks' as success, independent of value.
contract_items.remote_state_updated: Stored state 0x200018e7, value1 0x20002688, bool 0x20002671 -- but only on the extended form; a real 'don't downgrade' guard means a short-form 'P1,' response does NOT overwrite already-stored extended state.
contract_items.ui_workflow_trigger: UNKNOWN which discrete UI action (if any) independently triggers S/!; the one confirmed non-UI trigger is 0xc440's own boot/reconnect calls (item 7/17).
contract_items.compatibility_requirement: Replacement must support both response forms and must not assume the Remote always parses 3 fields -- a short 'P1,' is valid and leaves extended state untouched, not an error.

contract_items.remote_producer_consumer: Producer/consumer: 0xc440 (shared with S). Sends '!0|' or '!1|' (AutoPilot's dispatch check never inspects the mode digit -- identical outcome either way).
contract_items.retry_timeout_behavior: Same 0xc440 send/parse path as S; the bulk-push gate's ~200-tick success window applies identically.
contract_items.remote_state_updated: 10 of 11 fields' storage destinations traced (open-questions.md item 1, not re-derived here); field 11 is never consumed (see item 16).
contract_items.compatibility_requirement: Replacement must emit exactly this 11-field shape; the Remote provably ignores field 11 and its trailing comma (see item 16) -- do not 'fix' this by emitting 10 fields.

contract_items.autopilot_behavior: RX handler stores mode digit verbatim into MODE[channel], sets STATE[channel]=5; channel_event_monitor (0x8a80) notices state 5 on its own poll and schedules event 15 with AUTOPILOT_LIVE_POSITION[channel].
contract_items.remote_producer_consumer: Producer: 0xb958 builds 'I<channel+1><digit>|' with the mode digit INVERTED (mode_param=0->'1', mode_param=1->'0'). Consumer: parses '<signed-number>,' (event 15).
contract_items.retry_timeout_behavior: Not separately documented beyond the general RX/response path; execution-confirmed round trip via tools/unicorn/virtual_link.py i.
contract_items.remote_state_updated: 0x20001908+channel*4 (per-channel storage), both sign values round-trip correctly.
contract_items.ui_workflow_trigger: PROBABLE -- same 'GO TO POINT'/Test-action family as G (item 1); not pinned to a specific button.
contract_items.compatibility_requirement: Replacement must accept the Remote's INVERTED mode digit convention (0<->1 swap happens on the Remote side, not re-inverted on receipt) and respond with live position for the requested channel.

contract_items.autopilot_behavior: I1| silently aliases channel-0's normal I-command path (completes normally). I9| decodes to out-of-bounds channel index 8; the 4-channel scan never visits it, so event 15 is never scheduled -- a genuine, silent dead end.
contract_items.remote_producer_consumer: Producer: FUN_0000b834 (position-query helper), selects I9|/I1| via mode byte *0x200018e7, waits up to ~1000-3000 ticks (6 retries), parses a signed-decimal response via FUN_0000b51c.
contract_items.retry_timeout_behavior: 6 retries, ~1000-3000 total ticks, then gives up silently (no error surfaced beyond the query simply not succeeding).
contract_items.remote_state_updated: Result stored at fixed scratch slot 0x200027f0 -- exhaustively confirmed to have exactly two writers (this function, and an unrelated one-time NVM boot-config loader reusing the same slot) and NO READERS anywhere. The parsed value is computed then discarded; it never reaches LL1/LL2.
contract_items.ui_workflow_trigger: The two 'click to confirm a limit position' moments inside FUN_0000de3c's Set-Limits sequence (item 8's sibling workflow).
contract_items.compatibility_requirement: A replacement need not make I9 succeed -- the Remote already discards its result. Timing must tolerate ~1000-3000 ticks of retry before the Remote's own timeout on I9.

contract_items.autopilot_behavior: Writes the wire delta into the per-channel record but does NOT compute a live target or dirty the persist buffer for mode 0/0x14 -- execution-confirmed this session (Gap Resolution A, tools/unicorn/virtual_link.py plus-interactive). Does NOT commit or arm a move by itself.
contract_items.remote_producer_consumer: Producer: FUN_000049c4, called from FUN_0000e670 (Auto-Mode config screen state machine) at 4 real call sites: A (0xf40c, screen 5, empty record) / B (0xf5a6, screen 5, no channel has data) -- both args (1,1,ch,1,0x00), gated by FUN_0000cd70's confirm-wait returning 1 (short click, 'record this point'); C (0xf60c, screen 10, args (1,1,ch,2,0x14)); D (0xf68c, screen 9, args (1,1,ch,0,0x14)).
contract_items.exact_wire_form: +<units><reserved>,<confirm1>,<confirm2>,<channel>,<mode><count><recordFields...>| ; mode is always 0x00 or 0x14 at these 4 sites, never 0x62.
contract_items.retry_timeout_behavior: Sites A/B: gated on FUN_0000cd70's blocking confirm/select wait (returns 1=short click/record, 2=long click >400ms with two-pulse haptic/end dialog). Sites C/D: reach FUN_0000b59c (ack wait) then render 'RUNNING' on success.
contract_items.remote_state_updated: Writes the confirmed point into the local per-channel record at the same +0xc/+0x10 delta convention the Remote's own builder reads back; local record only, does NOT itself send a bulk push or MC4.
contract_items.ui_workflow_trigger: CONFIRMED for A/B: 'Click'/'to rec A-D'/'Long-click to end' screen text, closed end to end (string -> input -> wire bytes). PROBABLE for C/D: 'RUNNING' after send is confirmed; the pre-send highlighted row label is an arithmetic extrapolation from other screens, not directly observed.
contract_items.compatibility_requirement: Replacement must NOT treat any interactive '+' (mode 0/0x14) as arming a drivable target -- this is proven false on both the Remote-intent side (three of four sites are point-recording/local-only) and the AutoPilot-execution side (this session's concrete result). Only the mode=0x62 bulk push (item 7) arms a target.

contract_items.autopilot_behavior: mode=0x62 (98, the only mode value >50 these paths use) crosses the compute+persist threshold: FUN_00004ca8 computes target=start+delta per channel, FUN_000043f0 persists the whole struct -- execution-confirmed end to end through a real G-mode-1 move-commit.
contract_items.remote_producer_consumer: TWO distinct Remote-side triggers, not one: (a) FUN_0000c440's tail -- loops every channel with nonzero stored data, sends '+' mode=0x62 confirm1=confirm2=1 param_4=0, THEN unconditionally sends MC4 regardless of push outcome; (b) FUN_0000b6f0, a structurally distinct sibling called from the UI pump FUN_0000c340 roughly every 250 ticks once first-sync is done and Quick Setup isn't active -- also bulk-pushes '+' for channels with data, but its own tail calls FUN_000049c4-then-FUN_00006800 and NEVER sends MC4.
contract_items.exact_wire_form: +1,1,1,<ch>,98,<count>,<fields...>| per nonzero-data channel, then (path a only) MC4<...>| once for all channels
contract_items.retry_timeout_behavior: Path (a)'s gate: 0xc440's own 'S|'->'P...' round trip succeeding cleanly within ~200 ticks (any response shape, value irrelevant) is the sole condition -- independent of whether any '+' actually sent. Push loop itself additionally requires 0x20000fa0 ('has real programmed data') nonzero, set only by interactive UI (FUN_0000e670 or FUN_0000d218), never by boot.
contract_items.remote_state_updated: None beyond the ack bookkeeping the '+' and MC4 sends share with items 1/6/9.
contract_items.ui_workflow_trigger: Path (a) fires from: the Remote's own boot sequence (Reset_Handler->0x16900->0xfdf0->0xc440(0), unconditional, once per power-on) and a debounced reconnect re-arm (0x10ce4's ['a','x']/'B' byte dispatch, gated on first-sync latch 0x20000fc9==0, reset only by a real ~5000-tick radio-silence gap). Path (b) fires periodically from UI pump activity, not a discrete user action.
contract_items.compatibility_requirement: A cold/fresh boot's push loop is EMPTY (0x20000fa0 unset) -- only MC4 fires. Replacement AutoPilot must not assume a nonzero target appears on every boot; it appears only after (1) some channel has UI-set 'has data' state AND (2) either a fresh Remote boot or a ~5000-tick communication gap has occurred. The periodic path (b) never sends MC4 -- do not conflate a periodic push with a boot/reconnect event.

contract_items.autopilot_behavior: Checked before any ASCII command. 0xE0's per-record field layout is byte-identical to 0xF0's; 0xE0 additionally latches per-channel state to suppress repeat at-limit calls; no dead-man/timeout exists on the AutoPilot side for either frame family -- all execution-confirmed this session (Gap Resolution A/B, tools/unicorn/virtual_link.py manual-f0e0).
contract_items.remote_producer_consumer: Producer: FUN_0000be94, called every UI pump tick from the live-jog loop FUN_0000de3c for as long as the jog wheel is not clicked. Feeds from a real velocity-sensitive quadrature encoder (SAMD51 EIC pins 0x31/0x32, callback FUN_00007de8) via shared globals 0x20001818 (sign) / 0x2000181c (magnitude), accumulated into 0x20001714 clamped to [-100,100].
contract_items.exact_wire_form: <0xF0/0xE0><len=0x07+4*N><0xFFx4>[<channel nibble><sign+23-bit value>]*<'|'><seq>. Idle/heartbeat: b'\xf0\x07\xff\xff\xff\xff|'. One record: b'\xf0\x0b\xff\xff\xff\xff\x00LK@|' (channel 0, value 5,000,000).
contract_items.retry_timeout_behavior: None -- sent unconditionally every UI tick, including idle heartbeats with zero records. Stop is implicit: the Remote simply stops sending the instant the wheel is clicked (FUN_000171f0(0x2d), a real PORT.IN read); there is no explicit stop/zero-rate command.
contract_items.remote_state_updated: None beyond the accumulator (0x20001714) itself, reset to 0 after each send that isn't gated by the direction-invert flag.
contract_items.ui_workflow_trigger: CONFIRMED: the 'Direction' row of the 'MANUAL MODE' screen and the Set-Limits sub-flow both reach this same loop (structurally one live-jog engine, not two). Mode selection (0xF0 vs 0xE0), newly resolved this pass: FUN_0000be94 compares *0x200018e7 (the same screen/context-state byte that also selects the I9 vs I1 short form, item 5) against literal 3 -- ==3 selects mode 2 (0xE0), any other value selects mode 1 (0xF0). The specific UI screen state that sets 0x200018e7=3 was not traced (one hop beyond this bounded check).
contract_items.compatibility_requirement: Replacement must accept 0xF0/0xE0 as a pre-ASCII-check frame family, must not implement any dead-man/motion-decay timeout not present in the vendor (none found), and must treat 'frames stop arriving' as the sole stop signal.
evidence_refs: decompile of FUN_0000be94 via tools/ghidra/aptrace_ghidra.py (this pass)
contract_items.missing_fact: which specific UI screen/state sets *0x200018e7 == 3 (selecting 0xE0) was not traced -- one hop beyond FUN_0000be94 itself

contract_items.autopilot_behavior: 4 fields stored 0x2000006c/0x200000dc/0x200000f0/0x20000138 per channel; fields 1/3 (CURRENT, MICRO-STEPPING) consumed only by LCD display; field 2 (STEPS/S MAX) feeds a real fixed-point step-period computation; field 4 (RETURN SPEED) is a table index into a currently-blank config blob -- all execution/static-confirmed per Gap Resolution B (autopilot-replacement-gaps.json).
contract_items.remote_producer_consumer: Producer: FUN_00005a8c (sole builder of every MC frame, 3 call sites). MC<0-3>: 0x10cbe in FUN_00010698 (motor-settings numeric-row editor), sent every time a row is clicked out of (not once per motor). MC4 site 1: 0x1039e in FUN_00010258 ('Continue' on Choose-Type screen). MC4 site 2: 0xcb4c in FUN_0000c440's bulk-push tail (item 7).
contract_items.retry_timeout_behavior: Sent 3 times, with NO ack wait -- mechanically distinct from G/'+''s request/ack pattern. A harness/replacement must expect up to 3 identical transmissions and no acknowledgement.
contract_items.remote_state_updated: Per-motor-settings-page rows on the Remote itself; no Remote-side persistence confirmed beyond the current UI session (see item 19).
contract_items.ui_workflow_trigger: CONFIRMED, full chain (string -> input gesture -> state -> sender -> exact wire bytes) for MC<0-3> and MC4 site 1.
contract_items.compatibility_requirement: Replacement must tolerate 3x duplicate MC/MC4 sends with no ack expected, and should reproduce field 4's table-index semantics (not a direct speed value) for compatibility with the Remote's own 'RETURN SPEED' UI label.

contract_items.item: MT / Quick Setup initiation and completion
contract_items.autopilot_behavior: AutoPilot-initiated (not Remote-menu-initiated): sends MT exactly once per boot, unconditionally, from 4 real GPIO connector-presence probes (slot order A->b0, C->b1, B->b2, D->b3).
contract_items.remote_producer_consumer: Consumer only (Remote never sends MT): FUN_00010ce4 (inbound radio-command handler) reacts by assigning type 'Not connected' to any absent connector and opening the 'Motor <N>: Choose type' screen automatically. No Remote-side menu entry point into Quick Setup exists.
contract_items.exact_wire_form: MT<b0><b1><b2><b3><x>| (AutoPilot -> Remote); 5th field <x> is a single byte, always '1' or '2' in practice.
contract_items.retry_timeout_behavior: Not applicable -- unsolicited, single send, no ack protocol documented.
contract_items.remote_state_updated: Quick-Setup-in-progress flag (sole writer: FUN_00010ce4); per-motor type array defaults to 'Not connected' for absent slots.
contract_items.ui_workflow_trigger: 'Motor <N>: Choose type' screen opens automatically on MT receipt -- CONFIRMED, no Remote action required.
contract_items.compatibility_requirement: Replacement must send MT exactly once per boot (not periodic, not reconnect-driven) with the correct slot ordering (A/C/B/D, not naive A/B/C/D) for the Remote's Choose-Type screen to populate correctly.

contract_items.autopilot_behavior: Not applicable to the AutoPilot side directly -- Auto Mode editing is entirely Remote-local UI state until an interactive '+' (item 6) or bulk push (item 7) sends it.
contract_items.remote_producer_consumer: FUN_0000e670, the Auto-Mode configuration screen state machine, menu-index *0x200001a0 observed values 1-10; 4 real '+' call sites (item 6).
contract_items.exact_wire_form: N/A directly -- see item 6 for the wire form this state machine produces.
contract_items.remote_state_updated: Per-channel-per-mode local record (0x20000b20-based, item 12), same +0xc/+0x10 delta convention as the AutoPilot's own struct.
contract_items.ui_workflow_trigger: CONFIRMED for screen 5 (record A-D point). PROBABLE (arithmetic extrapolation, not directly observed) for screens 9/10's exact pre-send row label -- action-command-map.md Part 5 item 2, an open item unchanged by this pass.
contract_items.compatibility_requirement: A replacement Remote-compatibility layer does not need to replicate this UI state machine; it only needs to accept the wire forms it produces (items 6/7).
contract_items.missing_fact: exact pre-send highlighted-row label for screens 9/10 remains PROBABLE, not directly observed (pre-existing open item, not newly investigated)

contract_items.autopilot_behavior: Not applicable -- this is Remote-local state, mirroring but distinct from the AutoPilot's own 0x20001b40 struct (motor-config-persistence.md).
contract_items.remote_producer_consumer: Per-channel record array at 0x20000b20 (4 channels, same +0xc/+0x10 delta convention as the AutoPilot side). Existing evidence asserts it 'is loaded from Remote-local persisted flash storage during the same boot sequence' but does not cite a specific loader function/address.
contract_items.exact_wire_form: N/A -- local RAM/flash structure, not wire traffic.
contract_items.ui_workflow_trigger: Written by FUN_0000e670 (Auto-Mode UI, confirmed WRITE at 0xf47a) and read by FUN_0000b6f0/FUN_0000c440/FUN_000049c4 (the push paths, item 7).
contract_items.compatibility_requirement: A replacement Remote-compatibility layer only needs the wire-visible consequence (items 6/7); the Remote's own flash persistence internals are not required for AutoPilot-side replacement.
contract_items.missing_fact: which specific function loads 0x20000b20's record array from Remote-local NVM/flash at boot is not cited by existing evidence. Bounded xref query this pass (tools/ghidra/aptrace_ghidra.py xrefs mando868 0x20000b20) surfaced only already-known UI/push consumers (FUN_0000e670, FUN_0000c440, FUN_0000b6f0) -- no distinct loader function; likely reached via an indexed/computed write not visible to this xref query (same limitation already documented elsewhere in this project for 0x20001b14)

contract_items.remote_producer_consumer: Double-click cycles connected motor channels (user manual, only auto-detected-connected channels cycled). '+' commands use *0x2000180c-1 (1-based UI to 0-based wire convention, confirmed for items 6/9's call sites).
contract_items.exact_wire_form: See items 6/8/9 for the commands that carry a channel field.
contract_items.remote_state_updated: Current channel selection state (exact address not separately cited for the jog/0xF0-0xE0 path specifically).
contract_items.compatibility_requirement: Replacement should preserve the 1-based-UI/0-based-wire channel convention already confirmed for '+' and G.
contract_items.missing_fact: the exact RAM source feeding the 0xF0/0xE0 jog frame's own channel nibble was not separately confirmed to be the same *0x2000180c variable used by '+'/G (plausible by consistency, not directly cited)

contract_items.remote_producer_consumer: Consolidated across items 1/5/6/7/9: G/'+'(C/D) use the shared ack-wait 0xb59c-family mechanism; I9/I1 use 6 retries over ~1000-3000 ticks; S/!/bulk-push use a ~200-tick 'any clean response' gate; MC/MC4/LL1/LL2 send 3x with NO ack wait at all.
contract_items.retry_timeout_behavior: Summarized above; G's exact retry count/timeout duration is the one number not uniformly extracted from existing evidence (see item 1).
contract_items.compatibility_requirement: A replacement AutoPilot's response latency must fit within the ~200-tick (S/!) and ~1000-3000-tick (I9/I1) windows already documented; MC/MC4/LL1/LL2 require no response at all.
contract_items.missing_fact: G's exact 0xb59c retry count/timeout duration (same gap as item 1)

contract_items.remote_producer_consumer: The S/P parser has a real, confirmed 'don't downgrade' guard: a fresh device receiving the short form 'P1,' does NOT overwrite already-stored extended state.
contract_items.remote_state_updated: Stored S/P state is preserved (not corrupted) on a downgrade-shaped response.
contract_items.compatibility_requirement: Replacement must not assume sending a short-form 'P1,' clears or downgrades the Remote's previously-stored extended state -- it is explicitly ignored for that purpose.
contract_items.missing_fact: no general (non-S/P) malformed-packet handling has been traced anywhere in existing evidence; only this one specific guard is documented, mirroring the same gap already flagged for the AutoPilot side (autopilot-replacement-gaps.json, error/failure behavior)

contract_items.autopilot_behavior: ! emits 11 fields; I9 decodes to an out-of-bounds channel index (8) the 4-channel scan never visits.
contract_items.remote_producer_consumer: !'s parser (0xc440) calls its field parser exactly 10 times then unconditionally marks itself done -- field 11 and its trailing comma are left byte-for-byte UNCONSUMED in the real RX ring buffer (write pointer stays exactly len(field11)+1 bytes ahead of read, confirmed by direct pointer inspection). No error/assert/crash on either side. I9's sender (FUN_0000b834, item 5) just times out silently after its 6-retry window.
contract_items.retry_timeout_behavior: ! : no retry -- the leftover byte is simply never read. I9: 6 retries, ~1000-3000 ticks, then gives up.
contract_items.remote_state_updated: ! : none beyond the 10 consumed fields. I9: writes to 0x200027f0 (discarded, item 5).
contract_items.ui_workflow_trigger: N/A -- these are protocol-level facts, not UI-triggered.
contract_items.compatibility_requirement: These are documented, genuine firmware discrepancies, not bugs to fix in a harness or replacement per this project's own standing caution -- a replacement wishing strict Remote compatibility should preserve the 11-field '!' response shape and may leave I9 as a genuine dead end (the Remote already tolerates it).

contract_items.remote_producer_consumer: Same mechanism as item 7: FUN_0000c440 called unconditionally once per boot, and again on a debounced reconnect gated by the first-sync latch 0x20000fc9 (reset only by a real ~5000-tick radio-silence gap, not a periodic timer).
contract_items.retry_timeout_behavior: ~5000-tick (multi-second) gap in inbound AutoPilot radio activity, measured against the last-RX-activity timestamp, is the sole re-arm trigger.
contract_items.ui_workflow_trigger: None -- boot and communication-gap events, not user actions.
contract_items.compatibility_requirement: Replacement AutoPilot should expect an 'S|' probe and possible bulk push/MC4 both at Remote boot and after any ~5000-tick silence on its own transmit side.

contract_items.remote_producer_consumer: TX wrapper: flash 0x58a8 (shared calling convention with the AutoPilot's own 0x8c10). RX: LoRa receive poll/bytes-available/byte-read (0xb440/0xb4f8/0x583c), RX ring buffer at 0x20001773, read pointer 0x200017d7, write pointer 0x200017d8 -- cross-consistent across independent literal-pool reads. LoRa/SPI driver chain 0xb440 -> 0x11830 -> 0x11326/0x112e8, config struct 0x200038fc, constructor 0x1129c. The ring buffer feeds two consumers: a synchronous request parser and an async dispatcher (~0x10cf4/0x10ce4) for unsolicited AutoPilot-initiated frames like MT and T.
contract_items.exact_wire_form: N/A -- this is the transport layer beneath the wire forms in items 1-10.
contract_items.retry_timeout_behavior: N/A at this layer (retry semantics belong to the individual commands, items above).
contract_items.compatibility_requirement: A replacement need only match the logical packet boundary (byte-string framing, one command per RF payload) already characterized on the AutoPilot side -- exact Remote-side SX127x register configuration is a separate, non-blocking question (see below).
contract_items.missing_fact: exact Remote-side SX127x register setup (mode/frequency/sync-word/CRC/payload-length) is not established from current evidence -- the same class of gap already flagged and explicitly non-blocking on the AutoPilot side (autopilot-replacement-gaps.json, radio transport). Marked separately per this task's own instruction; does not block protocol-contract closure.

contract_items.autopilot_behavior: AutoPilot's own D-command/motor-target persistence is fully characterized (autopilot-replacement-gaps.json, persistence/NVM: COMPLETE).
contract_items.remote_producer_consumer: MC/MC4 (item 9) are sent 3x with NO ack wait -- the Remote does not wait for or require any confirmation that the AutoPilot actually persisted the config; existing evidence explicitly notes no persistence mechanism connecting MC0-MC4 to the AutoPilot's flash-backed config has been found (user-guide-workflows.md workflow 2), i.e. the manual's claim that Quick Setup config persists across power-off is not yet independently confirmed on the wire/persistence side.
contract_items.remote_state_updated: None beyond its own UI rows.
contract_items.compatibility_requirement: Replacement is free to persist MC/MC4 settings however it chooses -- the Remote has no wire-visible expectation of an ack or of any specific persistence mechanism, only that the fields it sent are the fields the AutoPilot's own settings display should reflect if queried again (not itself proven either).
contract_items.missing_fact: whether the manual's claim ('Quick Setup config persists across power-off') has any real firmware-backed mechanism remains unconfirmed -- a pre-existing open item, not newly investigated this pass

investigations_performed.target: FUN_0000be94 (mando868, target function only, no additional hop)
investigations_performed.method: bounded decompile via tools/ghidra/aptrace_ghidra.py decompile mando868 0xbe94
investigations_performed.result: Found the exact 0xF0-vs-0xE0 mode selection: *0x200018e7 == 3 selects mode 2 (0xE0); otherwise mode 1 (0xF0). 0x200018e7 is the same already-known screen/context-state byte used elsewhere to select I9 vs I1 (item 5).

investigations_performed.target: 0x20000b20 xref query (mando868, existing census tooling, no decompile)
investigations_performed.result: No distinct boot-time flash-loader function found -- only already-known UI/push consumers (FUN_0000e670, FUN_0000c440, FUN_0000b6f0) reference this address. Left MISSING per this pass's one-hop bound; likely reached via an indexed/computed access invisible to literal-pool xref scanning, matching a known limitation already documented elsewhere in this project.
